name: life-value-advisor
description: A life cost-value advisor grounded in the 672 evidence-based tips of 《高性价比人生指南》, judging whether things are worth it, safe, or risky.

displayDescription.en: Grounded in 672 evidence-based tips, helps you quickly judge whether something is worth it, safe, or risky using a cost-benefit framework.
displayDescription.zh: 基于《高性价比人生指南》672条循证建议，用成本收益框架帮你评判一件事划不划算、安不安全、有无坑。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我用成本收益框架评判一件事划不划算
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me judge whether something is worth it using the cost-benefit framework

quickPrompts.zh: 遇到要签字、借钱、投资的事，先帮我查有没有坑
